fusions.name: Tine Between Plates
fusions.desc: Gores an enemy and deals 30 piercing damage, ignoring armour, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Rack Shove
fusions.desc: Shoves with your antlers and deals 12 blunt damage to everything 3 tiles ahead, knocking it 2.5 tiles back, with a 50% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Barded Spring
fusions.desc: You spring 2 tiles, then your armour rises by 20% for 10 seconds and your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Near-Miss Mail
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
